layout_and_navigation.grid_structure: Mode B High Density Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-6 p-6

verdict_card.rule: High-contrast hero badge with animated pulse ring. Use bold green for Clean, red for High Suspicion, burnt orange for Medium Suspicion, and warm amber for Inconclusive.
verdict_card.eburnean_role: Ivory (#F5EFE6) highlight pill for 'ANOMALY DETECTED' & 'UNEXPECTED ARTIFACT' warnings to create bespoke military/tactical contrast against deep navy.

file_diff_viewer.style: JetBrains Mono code, line numbers, line-by-line highlight (red deletions, green additions, yellow token changes), sticky diff headers with file hash and size deltas.
file_categories: Repo-Only (Omitted files e.g. tests, CI workflows)

ai_explanation_panel.rule: Clearly separated from deterministic verdicts. Marked with distinct 'AI Heuristic Summary' banner, confidence metric, AST-level behavior insight, and MITRE ATT&CK supply chain mapping (T1195.002).

samples.name: fast-schema-validator (PyPI)
samples.tamper_type: Ghost File Injected in Wheel (.so / setup.py hook)

samples.name: auth-jwt-helper (npm)
samples.tamper_type: Telemetry Backdoor in minified bundle vs TypeScript source

instructions_to_main_agent: Build out the entire cybersecurity dashboard in React js with modern Tailwind CSS and Lucide icons.
Support PyPI and npm package analysis forms (ecosystem dropdown, package name input, version input, repository URL auto-detection or override).
Provide interactive Run Analysis with instant rich mock engine and support for custom queries.
Implement real working side-by-side diff viewer with file tree selector, category filters (Package-only, Repo-only, Modified, Identical, Expected-generated).
Implement the 'Synthetic Tampered Samples Lab' with 1-click 'Load & Inspect' into the analyzer and file diff viewer.
Use Recharts for Verdict Distribution (Donut / Pie), Risk Score History (AreaChart), Ecosystem breakdown (BarChart), and Anomaly Categories (Radial/Bar).
Implement Watchlist manager with active polling interval config (15m, 1h, 6h, 24h), release history drawer, and real-time security alerts feed.
Include an explicit 'AI Triage Explanation' panel toggleable per finding, displaying deterministic rules vs LLM heuristic assessment.
Every clickable or data element MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='run-analysis-btn', data-testid='file-category-package-only', data-testid='verdict-badge').

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.anti_ai_slop: Never use pure #000000 or generic full-screen saturated gradients. Use deep midnight navy #070B14 and rich surface #0D1424 with 1px border lines #1E2C47.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.eburnean_accent: Highlight critical security anomaly tags with Eburnean Ivory (#FDFBF7 / #F5EFE6) with subtle glow to make findings immediately eye-catching during live demonstration.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.spacing: Ensure cards have p-6 internal padding, generous gaps (gap-6 or gap-8), and clean scanability for live demo.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.accessibility: High-contrast text on all interactive and hover states. Monospace numbers for hashes, byte counts, and timestamps.
